description: A baseball player in a white home uniform with orange piping and an orange-and-black cap runs along a dirt path toward a brick wall, reaching out to slap hands with fans leaning over it. Stadium floodlights glow in a dark night sky, a brick grandstand with lit windows rises behind, and orange and white balloons float above. An orange logo sits on the cap and a partial orange script letter is on the jersey; the image fills edge to edge with no frame.
